series.name: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - insulation, residual current and earth faults
series.notes: Insulation/leakage family, all four rows sit together in the H1 V1.6 table between the PV-current and temperature rows. The manual's own remedy for all four is identical and weak (check wire insulation, wait, seek help) - the concrete steps below are field practice built around FoxESS's stated check, not invented FoxESS text. CRITICAL: 'Iso Fault' here is an insulation-DAMAGE inspection. The T-series 'ISO fault' is a measured-impedance test (should be > 100 kOhm) and the R-series 1124 is a two-step impedance check with an APP setting. Three different official remedies for the same word - never merge. The H1 manual also states, in section 6, that an earth-fault alarm shows as 'Isolation fault' on screen with the RED LED lit.

meaning.en: The inverter's insulation monitor measured a leakage path to earth and stopped. This is a damaged-insulation alarm, not a settings alarm.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka insulation monitor ne earth par leakage path naapa aur unit band kar di. Yeh kharabi-insulation ka alarm hai, settings ka nahi.

causes.en: Damaged or chafed cable insulation, classically where a PV cable runs through a metal roof edge, conduit or a hot cable tray.
causes.ur: Insulation damage ya ghis chuka cable - aam tor par jahan PV cable metal roof ke kinare, conduit ya garm cable tray se guzarta hai.

causes.en: Water ingress into a DC junction box, MC4 connector or the AC cable gland in monsoon season.
causes.ur: Barish ke mausam mein DC junction box, MC4 connector ya AC cable gland mein paani ka dakhil.

causes.en: Moisture on PV module surfaces after heavy dew or rain, which is normal and self-clears; a persistent alarm is not.
causes.ur: Bohat oos ya barish ke baad PV module ki sath par nami - yeh normal hai aur khud clear hota hai; lekin alarm bar qatam na ho to masla hai.

causes.en: A single module with a cracked backsheet or a failed junction box internally shorting to frame.
causes.ur: Aisa module jiska backsheet toota ho ya junction box kharab ho aur frame ke sath short kar raha ho.

solutions.en: Wait first and re-read the code after 15-30 minutes; FoxESS explicitly says to wait, because dew and damp mornings clear on their own.
solutions.ur: Pehle intezar karein aur 15-30 minute baad code dobara dekhein; FoxESS khud kehta hai intezar karein, kyunke oos aur nam subah khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker, then split the array: disconnect one string at a time at the DC switch and re-test to find the leaking string, working down to individual MC4 pairs if needed - the offending pair will read normal when reconnected.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker kholein, phir array ko alag karein: DC switch par ek-ek string disconnect kar ke dobara test karein taake leak wali string mil jaye, zaroori ho to MC4 joriyon tak neeche jayein - kharab jora wapas lagne par normal par ayega.

solutions.en: If no string is at fault, have a megohmmeter test done: PV+ to earth and PV- to earth should read in the megaohm range on a dry day.
solutions.ur: Agar koi string ghalat na lage to megohmmeter test karwayein: PV+ se earth aur PV- se earth ko sukhe din mein megaohm range par padhna chahiye.

notes.en: FoxESS's H1 manual names this row 'Iso Fault' but its section 6 earth-fault note calls the on-screen code 'Isolation fault' - treat the two spellings as the same code. Do not confuse with the T-series 'ISO fault' (impedance > 100 kOhm) or R-series 1124.
notes.ur: FoxESS ki H1 manual is row ko 'Iso Fault' kehti hai lekin section 6 ki earth-fault note par on-screen code 'Isolation fault' aata hai - dono spelling ek hi code samjhein. T-series ke 'ISO fault' (impedance > 100 kOhm) ya R-series ke 1124 se confuse na karein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The measured residual current on the AC side exceeded the inverter's limit, so it stopped to protect people and the earth path.
meaning.ur: AC side par measured residual current inverter ki limit se upar chala gaya, is liye unit ne logo aur earth path ko bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Same wet-weather or chafed-insulation causes as Iso Fault; this is the measured consequence of the leak.
causes.ur: Iso Fault jaisi hi geeli mausam ya gis chuki insulation ki wajahein; yeh us leak ka measured natija hai.

causes.en: Leakage through an anti-islanding or RCD-type device fitted in the wrong place, or a filter capacitor in the inverter itself.
causes.ur: Galat jagah laga hua anti-islanding ya RCD device se leakage, ya inverter ke apne filter capacitor se leakage.

causes.en: An upstream 30 mA RCD instead of the bi-directional 100 mA RCD FoxESS requires, which nuisance-trips or confuses the leakage budget.
causes.ur: FoxESS ki requirement ke mutabiq bi-directional 100 mA RCD ke bajaye upstream 30 mA RCD, jo leakage budget ko confuse karta hai.

solutions.en: Wait and re-read the code, as FoxESS directs, before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhune se pehle, jaise FoxESS kahe, intezar karke code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all loads at the distribution board one by one with the inverter still running; if the alarm clears, the leak is in a downstream appliance circuit.
solutions.ur: Inverter chalta rahe karte hue distribution board se loads ek-ek karke disconnect karein; agar alarm clear ho jaye to leak kisi downstream appliance circuit mein hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the earth/PE conductor is sound and bonded at the inverter, and confirm the RCD is the FoxESS-specified bi-directional 100 mA type.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke earth/PE conductor theek hai aur inverter par bond hai, aur RCD FoxESS ke mutabiq bi-directional 100 mA type ka hai.

notes.en: In Pakistan, dawn/dusk dew and a badly earthed consumer unit are the usual real causes. The manual gives no measurement value for this code, so do not quote one.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein subah/sham ki oos aur consumer unit ka kharab earthing hi aam asal wajahein hain. Manual is code ke liye koi measurement value nahi deta, is liye koi value na batayein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The residual-current sensing circuit itself (hardware, not insulation) reported a failure, so the inverter can no longer prove it is safe.
meaning.ur: Residual current sensing circuit khud (hardware, insulation nahi) ne kharabi batayi, is liye inverter ab saabit nahi kar sakta ke wo mehfooz hai.

causes.en: The current-sensing transformer or its conditioning electronics has drifted or failed with age and heat.
causes.ur: Current-sensing transformer ya us ki conditioning electronics umar aur garmi ke saath drift ya kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: A power surge or an earlier earth-fault event that damaged the sensing board.
causes.ur: Power surge ya pehle ka koi earth-fault event jis ne sensing board nuqsaan diya.

causes.en: Moisture or insects inside the enclosure reaching the sensing board.
causes.ur: Enclosure ke andar nami ya keede sensing board tak pahunche.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely, then reconnect once as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect kar ke, jaise FoxESS kahe, aik baar wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Open the unit only with mains and battery both dead and confirm the sensing board has no burn marks or residue before quoting a board.
solutions.ur: Unit kholein, magar sirf tab jab mains aur battery dono murda ho, aur board quote karne se pehle sensing board par burn marks ya residue check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns on an idle, dry, unloaded unit, raise a service claim with the code and serial number - this is not a wiring fault.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh khali, sukhe aur bina load ke unit par wapas aaye to code aur serial number ke saath service claim raise karein - yeh wiring fault nahi.

notes.en: Distinguish from Res Cur Fault: Res Cur Fault is a real leakage current in the installation, Res Cur HW Fault is the detector failing. Swap the inverter only after you have cleared the installation.
notes.ur: Res Cur Fault se farq karein: Res Cur Fault installation mein asal leakage current hai, Res Cur HW Fault detector ki kharabi hai. Installation saaf kiye bagair inverter mat badlein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The inverter measured an abnormal voltage between neutral and protective earth, or lost a proper ground reference.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan abnormal voltage naapa, ya theek ground reference kho di.

causes.en: Neutral and PE are not both correctly landed at the inverter's AC terminal, or PE is open.
causes.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par neutral aur PE dono theek se nahi lage, ya PE khari hui hai.

causes.en: Neutral and PE are shorted together somewhere in the distribution board, which is common in improvised Pakistani wiring.
causes.ur: Distribution board mein kahin neutral aur PE aapas mein short ho gaye hain - Pakistan ke improvised wiring mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Reversed or mis-landed conductors at the AC terminal after a rewire by a non-installer.
causes.ur: Kisi non-installer ke rewire ke baad AC terminal par conductors ulat ya ghalat lagi hui.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker, open the PV DC switch and the battery isolator, and confirm the inverter is fully dead before touching the earth bar.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, PV DC switch aur battery isolator kholein, aur earth bar chhune se pehle confirm karein ke inverter poori tarah murda hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage between neutral and PE at the inverter; it should read near zero volts while the grid is live.
solutions.ur: Inverter par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan AC voltage napen; grid live hone ke bawajood yeqreeban zero volts ka hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring end to end: land PE and N separately on the inverter's own terminals, and re-torque every AC terminal.
solutions.ur: AC wiring aakhir tak check karein: PE aur N ko inverter ke apne terminals par alag alag lagayein, aur har AC terminal dobara torque karein.

notes.en: The T-series 'Ground fault' gives the same two checks (neutral-to-PE voltage, then AC wiring) but adds a PV DC switch-off step; keep the two separate. Neutral-PE shorting is a fire risk, not just a nuisance alarm.
notes.ur: T-series ka 'Ground fault' wahi do checks deta hai (neutral se PE voltage, phir AC wiring) lekin PV DC switch off ka step bhi add karta hai; dono alag rakhein. Neutral-PE short aag ka khatra hai, sirf pareshani ka alarm nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)
